# Agent registry

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:agent-registry` · **Epic:** [#70](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/70) · **Tickets:** 4 (1S 3M)

Adds a CP-managed registry of agents so the token service knows which agents exist, who owns them, which public key authenticates them, and which user groups may delegate to them. Operators manage agents in the console instead of implicit port-based ids only.

## How we build it

- Table `agents` in CP state DB: id (slug, matches the existing config `agents[].id` and agentid port label where used), owner (sub), display_name, public_jwks (JSON, 1-2 keys to allow agent key rotation), allowed_groups []string, environments []string, default_scope string, identity_mode off|attribute|require, status active|disabled, created_at, updated_at.
- Store interface `AgentStore { Get, List, Put, SetStatus }` in new package internal/agentreg so the Phase 5 Postgres store can implement it.
- Admin API: `GET/POST /api/agents`, `GET/PUT /api/agents/{id}`, `POST /api/agents/{id}/disable`; editor+ role to write, viewer to read; every write audited via P1 admin audit.
- Public key accepted only as JWK (OKP Ed25519 or EC P-256); private keys never accepted or stored.
- Registry version is included in the served policy wire so workers learn identity_mode and status per agent on the existing long-poll.

## Done when

An admin can register an agent with a public JWK and allowed groups in the console, and the token service and workers read that record.

### 1/4 · W-P2-AREG-01

**Add internal/agentreg store and SQLite schema**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#71](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/71)

Create new package internal/agentreg with the Agent struct, AgentStore interface and a SQLite implementation over the CP state DB (migration `agents` table). Validate JWKs on Put (kty/crv allowlist, no `d` member, max 2 keys), ids as `^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$`, and groups non-empty for active agents.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Put rejects a JWK containing a private member
- [ ] Put/Get round-trip preserves all fields
- [ ] Disabled agents are returned with status=disabled, not deleted

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-AREG-02`](agent-registry.md#24--w-p2-areg-02) Expose agent registry admin API with role checks and audit; [`W-P2-AREG-04`](agent-registry.md#44--w-p2-areg-04) Ship per-agent identity mode in the policy wire; [`W-P2-TOKX-01`](token-exchange.md#15--w-p2-tokx-01) Add private_key_jwt client assertion verification

### 2/4 · W-P2-AREG-02

**Expose agent registry admin API with role checks and audit**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#72](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/72)

Mount `/api/agents` routes in internal/controlplane behind the P1 console session middleware (and API-key middleware once available). Writes require editor or admin; each write emits an admin audit entry with actor, agent id and changed fields (never key material beyond kid).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Viewer gets 403 on POST
- [ ] Audit entry recorded for create, update and disable
- [ ] Invalid JWK returns 400 with a field error

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-AREG-01`](agent-registry.md#14--w-p2-areg-01) Add internal/agentreg store and SQLite schema

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-AREG-03`](agent-registry.md#34--w-p2-areg-03) Add Agents page to the CP dashboard; [`W-P2-WCA-02`](worker-mtls.md#26--w-p2-wca-02) Add enrollment tokens and POST /enroll endpoint

### 3/4 · W-P2-AREG-03

**Add Agents page to the CP dashboard**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#73](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/73)

Add an Agents tab to internal/dashboard (index.html + dashboard_v3 handlers via a new SetAgentsSource/SetAgentsWriter seam, mirroring SetIntegrationsWriter) listing agents with owner, groups, identity mode, status and key kids; form to create/edit and paste a public JWK. Workers do not get the writer (405), same as other CP-only editors.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Agent created in UI appears via GET /api/agents
- [ ] Worker dashboard returns 405 on agent writes
- [ ] Key kid, not the JWK body, is shown in the list view

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-AREG-02`](agent-registry.md#24--w-p2-areg-02) Expose agent registry admin API with role checks and audit

### 4/4 · W-P2-AREG-04

**Ship per-agent identity mode in the policy wire**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#74](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/74)

Extend controlplane.policyWire with `agents: [{id, identityMode, status}]` (omitempty for back-compat) built from AgentStore, and parse it in config.parseRemotePolicy into a new `config.AgentIdentity` slice exposed to the worker. A registry write calls s.refresh() so long-poll waiters receive it immediately.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Old workers ignore the new key (back-compat test with existing parseRemotePolicy fixtures)
- [ ] Changing identityMode wakes a pending /policy long-poll
- [ ] Disabled agent appears with status=disabled in the wire

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-AREG-01`](agent-registry.md#14--w-p2-areg-01) Add internal/agentreg store and SQLite schema

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-WBND-02`](identity-enforcement.md#25--w-p2-wbnd-02) Enforce cnf and agent binding for presented tokens
